[[/Maps|Non-interactive maps]] | pic2 = [[File:Crimson Skull Raisu Palace.jpg|196px]] | pic2-text = A docked [[Crimson Skull]] vessel }} [[Raisu Palace (explorable area)|Raisu Palace]] of the [[Canthan Emperor|Emperor of Cantha]] is an [[explorable area]] east of the [[Kaineng Center]]. Construction on the palace began in 510 [[Mouvelian calendar|BE]], commissioned by [[Kaineng Tah]]. It was burned down in 694 AE with [[Emperor Singtah]] inside. The palace began to be rebuilt in the same year, being finished over eighty years later and is considered the one great achievement of Emperor Senvho's reign. The palace features towering walls, elaborately-carved jade pathways, and intricately-decorated pagodas, and splendor that sets it worlds apart from the squalor of the [[Kaineng City]] poor. It even has an extensive private dock area on the northern side. ==Getting there== This explorable area can only be entered from the [[Imperial Sanctum (outpost)|Imperial Sanctum]] outpost, and is therefore only accessible after completion of the [[Raisu Palace]] mission. ==Exits== *[[Imperial Sanctum (outpost)|Imperial Sanctum]] (east) *[[Raisu Palace (outpost)|Raisu Palace]] (west; one-way exit) ==Shrines== ;Resurrection shrines with a [[statue]]: *[[Avatar of Dwayna (NPC)|Avatar of Dwayna]] **Northeast corner, north of [[Kuunavang]] and the [[Imperial Sanctum (outpost)|Imperial Sanctum]] exit. *[[Champion of Balthazar]] **North, the lower of the two dock ward paths, almost directly north of [[Sword Ancient Kai]]'s position. *[[Lyssa's Muse]] **Center, due west of the Imperial Sanctum exit, near the start of the "acid traps" part of the [[Raisu Palace|Raisu Palace mission]]. ==NPCs== ===Allies=== *{{e}} 30 (30) [[Kuunavang]] ===Foes=== [[Shiro'ken]] *{{w}} 28 (30) [[Shiro'ken Warrior]] *{{r}} 28 (30) [[Shiro'ken Ranger]] *{{mo}} 28 (30) [[Shiro'ken Monk]] *{{n}} 28 (30) [[Shiro'ken Necromancer]] *{{me}} 28 (30) [[Shiro'ken Mesmer]] *{{e}} 28 (30) [[Shiro'ken Elementalist]] *{{a}} 28 (30) [[Shiro'ken Assassin]] *{{rt}} 28 (30) [[Shiro'ken Ritualist]] ====Bosses==== [[Shiro'ken]] *{{w}} 28 (30) [[Sword Ancient Kai]] → [[Auspicious Parry]] ([[Kai's Sword]]) *{{r}} 28 (30) [[Famished Ancient Brrne]] → [[Famine]] ([[Brrne's Recurve Bow]]) *{{mo}} 28 (30) [[Untouched Ancient Ky]] → [[Spell Breaker]] ([[Ky's Chalice]]) *{{n}} 28 (30) [[Doomed Ancient Kkraz]] → [[Wail of Doom]] ([[Kkraz's Indulgence]]) *{{me}} 28 (30) [[Arcane Ancient Phi]] → [[Arcane Languor]] ([[Phi's Wisdom]]) *{{e}} 28 (30) [[Star Ancient Koosun]] → [[Star Burst]] ([[Koosun's Fire Staff]]) *{{a}} 28 (30) [[Silent Ancient Onata]] → [[Shroud of Silence]] ([[Onata's Shards]]) *{{rt}} 28 (30) [[Defiant Ancient Sseer]] → [[Soul Twisting]] ([[Sseer's Wish]]) *{{w}} {{rt}} {{a}} 28 (30) [[Blade Ancient Syu-Shai]] → [[Shadow Theft]], [[Weapons of Three Forges]], [[Seven Weapons Stance]] (only appears if a team member has a [[Proof of Triumph]] in their inventory) ==Notes== {{gw2w|Raisu Palace}} * There are globes of light scattered throughout the area.
